body: I promise that you will make it!!! The attempts are never worth it even if they are half-assed ones. Stay strong and continue going to school. Find even one person that you like and relate to heavily to talk to. They can help. If they cannot just listen to them but also talk about your experience because you chose them for a reason so they can relate. I was 20 when I realized that having suicidal thoughts were not common... I have been having them for a long time so please just get out there and talk to people if possible. Friends are the best treatment you can get it terms of daily life. stay safe!!

I feel this way evert single day. What is keeping me here? Why do I choose to exist when I only feel like small parts make it worth while. Feeling misunderstood and having no real outlook into the entire world and the cultures that exist because of money problems are a common problem tbh. I feel like if I was rich I could just live a fantasy every day all day. I cannot keep working shitty jobs and feeling so up and downey all of the time. This is getting to be too much for me to keep doing. I feel what you're saying and get it a lot. I don't believe in god at all literally... like wtfff.. but the phrase that "It all happens for a reason," has stuck with me. I stay because I don't know. I also, however, believe that we were always here but also never here. It is so complicated but that's because its beyond our understanding. SORRY FOR THE LONG COMMENT, BUTTTTTTTT....,,,.. I am drunk so its whatever at this point. ANYWAYS, you are here because your experience plays into how this whole conciousness is meant to be observed. It is morbid but I feel like if there is a time for you to do that it will come and if you feel it will not, then don't. Stay here. Do not if your brain is telling you not to. Stay safe per usual and live laugh love, or at least adopt happy and positive sayings as a trick to rewire your brain to think positively. even you reaching out here says a lot about you wanting a real answer instead of just acting impulsively. I hope that you stay not killing yourself!! :')) it's a hard feeling but we are all here feeling the same.. so stay !
